summary: Build practical Article 6 readiness, authorization, ITMO accounting, and reporting skills. Explore the course and plan your next steps.
lede: Paris Agreement Article 6 training addresses how institutions can operationalise cooperation and carbon-market procedures. It is for climate officials, regulators, NDC and MRV teams, project developers, development partners and finance-sector staff. Participants assess readiness, map authorization and corresponding-adjustment workflows, connect MRV information to reporting and registry controls, and develop an operational action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, regulate, support, or assess Article 6 cooperation and carbon-pricing participation. It is most relevant when your work involves authorization, NDC alignment, MRV, registry operations, project preparation, or climate finance.
prerequisites: Recommended background: working familiarity with climate policy, NDC implementation, MRV, carbon markets, or public-sector governance. No programming is required. Bring a laptop if you plan to work with digital templates; no software installation is specified.
